findings.title: Data race on shared counter
findings.description: processed += 1 is a non-atomic read-modify-write executed concurrently by up to 8 worker threads with no lock, so updates are lost and the returned total is wrong; guard it with a threading.Lock or use itertools.count/atomic aggregation.
findings.suggestion: Protect the increment with a threading.Lock (imported but unused) or collect results via pool.map return values.
